title: Sharp Counterfactual Bounds under Orientation Budgets for Piecewise-Affine Bijective Mechanisms
banked_reason: D-0.5 revision cap 6 exhausted: exact-rational applicability objection repeated after certified-surrogate scoping; remaining empty-cell and positive-visitation definitions are local, with no distinct in-scope root repair.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery produced a field-rated exact symbolic SCM proposal with a repaired primitive orientation characterization, a legal four-cell path witness and complete endpoint enumeration, a typed alternative-law fiber, stagewise DKW conditioning, and a theorem-by-theorem novelty audit. Six D-0.5 revisions exhausted the cap because the reviewer continued to require either stricter supplied-symbolic-input framing or a new approximation/misspecification transfer theorem; the latter would materially expand the fixed topic. No derivation or Lean formalization began, and the remaining empty-cell and positive-visitation definitions are explicitly preserved as local retry work.
tldr: Within a declared exact rational piecewise-affine SCM or certified surrogate, primitive continuous bijective cell mechanisms that generate fixed scalar conditional laws are rigid: each is the increasing quantile or its rank reflection, so an intrinsic graph-budgeted orientation field is derived rather than assumed. Positioned against published inverse-transport, bijective-generation, scalar monotone-generation and nonidentifiability, c-GNF equivalence, continuous-sensitivity, and discrete credal-network bounding results, the contribution is the bounded graph-local failure object: attained sharp conditional counterfactual hulls, a bounded-degree rational Boolean polynomial, exact continuous-rank integration before graph-width optimization with attaining SCM backpointers, and a legal four-cell path witness with non-strict nesting; generic counterfactual-bound optimization and the known zero-budget equality are not claimed as novel. Stagewise conditional DKW bands place the true exact-class quantile system in a same-support, endpoint-anchored alternative-law fiber and give an honest outer projection for every fixed or data-selected budget. The central open question asks for a terminating common-rank refinement algorithm whose finite-sample outer endpoints have deterministic optimization excess and converge almost surely to the sharp endpoints on the positive-visitation event. These conclusions concern the SCM or surrogate target under exact-class membership, not a nonmember physical data-generating law.
gap: Published inverse-transport, bijective-generation, scalar monotone-generation, and c-GNF results delimit complete counterfactual agreement and nonidentifiability regimes. Published continuous partial-identification work perturbs curvature or latent laws, while Duarte et al. and Zaffalon et al. compute bounds for discrete SCMs through polynomial or credal-network machinery. None provides the declared continuous endpoint-anchored observational fiber with bounded graph-local orientation failures, attained graph-TV conditional envelopes, a shared-rank Boolean compiler with attaining SCM backpointers, and stagewise DKW law-fiber projection. Generic counterfactual-bound optimization is therefore credited as prior art rather than treated as the gap.
fill: Conditional on exact-class membership, the project proves cellwise quantile-orientation rigidity from primitive continuous bijections and fixed pushforwards, derives the positive-budget global orientation fiber and attained sharp hull, validates the geometry on an explicit rational triangular witness, compiles continuous common-rank integrals into one reusable Boolean field, solves the augmented-width optimizer with attaining backpointers, and obtains simultaneous finite-sample coverage by projecting a same-support endpoint-anchored alternative-law fiber. The zero-budget equality is only a supporting known consistency check, and almost-sure contraction of a concrete certified common-rank projection remains the open question.
